framework_name: TRUST Lite — Simplified Academic Tool Review

data_privacy.title: Privacy policy
data_privacy.requirement: Can you find a privacy policy that explains what data the tool collects, what it does with your data, and whether it follows GDPR or similar protections?
data_privacy.basic_requirement: Look for a privacy policy on the tool's website. Does it say what data is collected, how it's used, and whether it follows GDPR? Provide a screenshot or link.

training_policy.title: Data usage for training
training_policy.requirement: Does the tool explicitly state that user inputs are NOT used to train AI models?
training_policy.basic_requirement: Does the tool say in writing that it won't use your questions or files to train its AI? Look in the privacy policy or terms of service.

citation_mechanism.title: Source references
citation_mechanism.requirement: Does the tool show clickable references for the information it provides? Most claims should have citations, and the links should work.
citation_mechanism.basic_requirement: When the tool gives you an answer, does it show links to where the information came from? It's okay if a few claims don't have links, but most should.

compliance.title: Accessibility
compliance.requirement: Can you use the tool with just a keyboard? Can you make the text bigger without breaking the layout? Does it work with screen readers?
compliance.basic_requirement: Try using the tool with just a keyboard — can you reach all the main features? Can you zoom in without the page breaking? Mark pass if keyboard navigation works and there's an accessibility statement.

data_source_clarity.title: Where does the data come from?
data_source_clarity.1: The tool mentions what kind of sources it uses but gives no specifics.
data_source_clarity.2: The tool names the specific databases or publishers it searches.
data_source_clarity.3: The tool provides a complete list of all its sources, including when they were last updated.
data_source_clarity.0_basic: There is no information about where the tool gets its data.
data_source_clarity.1_basic: The tool says it searches 'academic sources' but doesn't say which ones.
data_source_clarity.2_basic: The tool tells you which databases or publishers it uses.
data_source_clarity.3_basic: The tool provides a full list of every source it searches and when each was last updated.

methodology_disclosure.title: How does it work?
methodology_disclosure.0: No explanation of how the tool works.
methodology_disclosure.1: The tool just says it uses 'AI' without details.
methodology_disclosure.2: The tool names the specific AI technology it uses and explains how it finds information.
methodology_disclosure.3: The tool gives a complete step-by-step explanation of how it processes your question and generates an answer.
methodology_disclosure.0_basic: The tool doesn't explain how it works at all.
methodology_disclosure.1_basic: The tool only says 'powered by AI' without explaining what that means.
methodology_disclosure.2_basic: The tool explains the type of AI it uses (like a language model) and how it searches for information.
methodology_disclosure.3_basic: The tool gives a complete step-by-step explanation: how it finds sources, which AI model it uses, and how it builds its answer.

accuracy_and_hallucination.title: Is the information correct?
accuracy_and_hallucination.0: The tool frequently makes up incorrect facts or fake citations.
accuracy_and_hallucination.1: The tool is mostly correct but sometimes gets details wrong.
accuracy_and_hallucination.2: The tool is accurate with only small mistakes that don't change the meaning.
accuracy_and_hallucination.3: The tool consistently provides correct, verified information — everything checks out.
accuracy_and_hallucination.0_basic: The tool often gives wrong or made-up information.
accuracy_and_hallucination.1_basic: Mostly correct, but you've caught some mistakes in details.
accuracy_and_hallucination.2_basic: Very few errors — mostly small details that don't matter much.
accuracy_and_hallucination.3_basic: Everything the tool says checks out as accurate when you verify it.

variance_consistency.title: Are the results consistent?
variance_consistency.0: Asking the same question twice gives completely different conclusions.
variance_consistency.1: Answers vary noticeably between tries — you need to ask a few times to get a good result.
variance_consistency.2: The main answers are consistent, though the wording may differ slightly.
variance_consistency.3: The tool gives the same substantive answer every time you ask the same question.
variance_consistency.0_basic: Completely different conclusions each time you ask the same thing.
variance_consistency.1_basic: Noticeably different results — you need to ask a few times to get a good answer.
variance_consistency.2_basic: Mostly consistent with minor variations in wording.
variance_consistency.3_basic: Same substance every time — the core answer doesn't change.

workflow_integration.title: Can you export or save results?
workflow_integration.0: No way to save or export your results.
workflow_integration.1: You can only copy and paste results manually.
workflow_integration.2: You can download references in standard formats (BibTeX, RIS).
workflow_integration.3: The tool connects directly to reference managers like Zotero.
workflow_integration.0_basic: No save or export option at all.
workflow_integration.1_basic: You can highlight and copy text, but that's it.
workflow_integration.2_basic: There's an export button that saves references as files.
workflow_integration.3_basic: The tool has a direct connection to Zotero, EndNote, or similar tools.

cognitive_guardrails.title: Does the tool help you think critically?
cognitive_guardrails.0: The tool presents answers as final facts with no warnings or source links.
cognitive_guardrails.1: There's a generic 'check your sources' disclaimer but nothing else.
cognitive_guardrails.2: The tool shows original source text alongside its answers so you can compare.
cognitive_guardrails.3: The tool has built-in features that help you compare sources and check for accuracy.
cognitive_guardrails.0_basic: No warnings or prompts — answers look like final facts.
cognitive_guardrails.1_basic: A small disclaimer says 'always verify your sources'.
cognitive_guardrails.2_basic: The tool shows original sources and encourages you to read them.
cognitive_guardrails.3_basic: The tool actively helps you verify — prompting you to compare sources, check for bias, or double-check claims.

algorithmic_fairness.title: Is the tool fair and balanced?
algorithmic_fairness.0: Results appear systematically biased and the tool doesn't acknowledge it.
algorithmic_fairness.1: The tool mentions that bias might exist but doesn't show evidence of doing anything about it.
algorithmic_fairness.2: The tool either shows diverse results in practice or documents how it tries to be fair.
algorithmic_fairness.3: The tool both shows diverse results and publishes reports about its fairness efforts.
algorithmic_fairness.0_basic: Nothing suggests the tool tries to be fair or balanced — results seem one-sided.
algorithmic_fairness.1_basic: The tool acknowledges bias could be an issue but doesn't do much about it.
algorithmic_fairness.2_basic: You can see diverse results in the tool, or it documents how it works to be fair.
algorithmic_fairness.3_basic: The tool both shows diverse results and publishes reports about how it tries to be fair.

data_handling.title: How does the tool protect your data?
data_handling.0: No clear information about data retention or security.
data_handling.1: The privacy policy mentions data protection but doesn't give specifics.
data_handling.2: The tool clearly states how long it keeps your data and that it uses encryption.
data_handling.3: The tool provides full details: how long data is kept, how it's encrypted, and how you can delete your data.
data_handling.0_basic: It's unclear what happens to your data after you use the tool.
data_handling.1_basic: The tool says your data is 'protected' but doesn't explain how.
data_handling.2_basic: The tool tells you how long it stores your data and that it's encrypted.
data_handling.3_basic: The tool explains everything: storage time, encryption, what happens if there's a security breach, and how to delete your data.

source_attribution_depth.title: Do the source links work and go deep?
source_attribution_depth.0: Sources are missing or links are broken.
source_attribution_depth.1: Links go to a journal homepage, not the specific article.
source_attribution_depth.2: Links go to the specific article's abstract.
source_attribution_depth.3: Links go to the exact part of the source that supports the claim.
source_attribution_depth.0_basic: No source links, or clicking them leads nowhere useful.
source_attribution_depth.1_basic: Links take you to the journal's website but not the specific article.
source_attribution_depth.2_basic: Links take you to the right article.
source_attribution_depth.3_basic: Links take you to the exact paragraph or section that supports the claim.

bibliometric_credibility.title: Are the sources trustworthy?
bibliometric_credibility.0: The tool includes retracted or low-quality sources without warning.
bibliometric_credibility.1: The tool doesn't filter or label source quality.
bibliometric_credibility.2: The tool labels sources as peer-reviewed or preprint.
bibliometric_credibility.3: The tool shows detailed quality info: retraction status, citation counts, and publication type.
bibliometric_credibility.0_basic: The tool cites papers that have been withdrawn or come from unreliable publishers, without any warning.
bibliometric_credibility.1_basic: The tool doesn't tell you if sources are good quality or not.
bibliometric_credibility.2_basic: The tool labels whether each source is peer-reviewed or a preprint.
bibliometric_credibility.3_basic: The tool shows detailed info for each source: whether it was retracted, how many times it was cited, and what type of publication it is.
